_meta.principle: Palette + emotion resolution. Maps emotion-name → color treatment. Single source of truth for translating viewer emotion into palette. When colorPsychology='auto' is passed to the composer, the composer resolves which preset to use via the emotion field by matching against `emotion_keys`.
sources: Higgsfield AI tutorial transcript 2026-05-03 (color psychology mapping)
Patti Bellantoni, If It's Purple, Someone's Gonna Die (cinematic color theory)
_meta.interpolation_rule: Paste fragment verbatim into the color clause. emotion_keys is consulted ONLY when caller passes colorPsychology='auto' + an emotion.

tension_red_amber.name: Tension red / amber
tension_red_amber.use: Anger, intensity, urgency, danger, emotionally charged confrontations.
tension_red_amber.fragment: color palette dominated by reds, ambers, and warm tones, high saturation in the warm range, deep shadows holding contrast, the visual heat of an emotionally charged scene

calm_blue_grey.name: Calm blue / grey
calm_blue_grey.use: Calmness, isolation, distance, contemplation. The cool emotional opposite of tension red.
calm_blue_grey.fragment: color palette dominated by cool blues and neutral greys, desaturated warm tones, the still cool quality of contemplation or emotional distance

nostalgia_warm_sepia.name: Nostalgia warm sepia
nostalgia_warm_sepia.use: Memory, longing, the past, faded warmth. Family photos, period pieces, looking back.
nostalgia_warm_sepia.fragment: warm sepia-tinted palette, slight desaturation overall but warmth preserved in skin tones, faded highlights and gentle shadows, the visual quality of memory

isolation_cool_desaturated.name: Isolation cool desaturated
isolation_cool_desaturated.use: Loneliness, alienation, depression, stark emotional distance. Stronger than calm-blue — pulls saturation way down.
isolation_cool_desaturated.fragment: cool desaturated palette with most color drained from the scene, blue-grey shadows, slight warmth only in skin tones, the visual emptiness of isolation or depression

intimacy_warm_skin_tones.name: Intimacy warm skin tones
intimacy_warm_skin_tones.use: Tender moments, family, romance, vulnerability. Warm palette but saturation pulled gently — not garish.
intimacy_warm_skin_tones.fragment: warm palette pushed toward natural skin tones, gentle saturation in oranges and warm pinks, soft contrast, the visual closeness of an intimate moment

clinical_cool_neutral.name: Clinical cool neutral
clinical_cool_neutral.use: Medical, technical, institutional, sterile. Hospitals, labs, corporate. Cold, clean, no emotion.
clinical_cool_neutral.fragment: clinical cool neutral palette, slight blue-green tint, minimal saturation, even lighting that erases warmth, the sterile institutional quality of a hospital or lab

dread_green_sickly.name: Dread sickly green
dread_green_sickly.use: Horror, illness, decay, unease. The Matrix / Fincher palette. Faces look unwell.
dread_green_sickly.fragment: sickly green-yellow tinted palette, cool and slightly bilious, skin tones pushed unhealthy, the visual quality of dread or impending wrongness

joy_saturated_pop.name: Joy saturated pop
joy_saturated_pop.use: Celebration, energy, summer, advertising-bright happiness. Punch up everything.
joy_saturated_pop.fragment: highly saturated palette across the spectrum, every color brought to peak intensity, bright primaries and complementaries punching out of the frame, the visual exuberance of joy

serenity_pastel_low_contrast.name: Serenity pastel low-contrast
serenity_pastel_low_contrast.use: Soft mornings, quiet domesticity, gentle wellness. Pastels, low contrast, breathy.
serenity_pastel_low_contrast.fragment: soft pastel palette with low contrast, gentle pinks, creams, and pale blues, highlights blooming softly, the breathy quiet quality of a peaceful morning

urgency_high_contrast_complementary.name: Urgency high-contrast complementary
urgency_high_contrast_complementary.use: Action, urgency, news, sport. Strong complementary color pairs (orange/teal, red/cyan), high contrast.
urgency_high_contrast_complementary.fragment: high-contrast complementary color palette (orange and teal, or red and cyan), strong saturation in both poles, deep shadows separating the two color regions, the urgent dynamic energy of an action scene
